items.title: Jerry Gordon interviewed by Monk Rowe and Christian Goodwillie, via Zoom, June 30, 2021
items.q: I saw him which remains to this day the — probably the greatest concert of my life.

ctx.x: Was he dressed as we are, as we remember him, in performance garb?

You know Sun Ra never wore jeans. I mean you wouldn’t see Sun Ra in jeans. You wouldn’t want to see Sun Ra in jeans. He had these platform shoes spray painted silver that he used to wear. And that was always cool. And he didn’t have headgear on or anything like that. But it was always Ra-like clothing.

You had said in an earlier interview that Sun Ra was always pushing forward, his whole thing was to turn on the light upstairs with as many people as he could come in contact with. So I’m wondering if he turned on any lights for you? Either at this time or later with Evidence?

items.title: Jerry Gordon interviewed by Monk Rowe and Christian Goodwillie, via Zoom, June 30, 2021
items.q: he flew into Philly and came to our office and he just gave us the satchel and left the satchel there

ctx.x: The first, I remember he flew into Philly and had like a leather satchel, like kind of beat up, and he had masters in there and he flew into Philly and he came to our office and he just gave us the satchel and left the satchel there. And I never got rid of it it was just like another holy Sun Ra artifact, this beat up satchel that he brought the masters in and he just left it there, you know, “Here.”
